name: Supporter Network - Nine Directions
description: The review deck Nicole opens once she is past the passphrase, which this scenario types rather than bypasses — so what is captured is the page as it actually ships, not a screenshot-only code path. Nine directions: seven network readings plus two off-brief controls that drop the graph entirely. Every card is the real renderer at card size rather than a screenshot, so a thumbnail cannot drift from the direction it opens. The cards carry no rating slider or comment box: reactions come back in a doc, so the deck asks for nothing and gets out of the way of the designs. Captured on Mobile as well as Desktop because the deck is shared as a link and a reviewer is as likely to open it on a phone — where the three-column grid has to collapse without the miniatures becoming unreadable. No seed: the page is fully self-contained, since a published artifact runs under a CSP that blocks every external host, so the 200 illustrative supporters are inlined rather than fetched.
